# Matthew Ovie Enamuotor

> Frontend and mobile developer based in London, Ontario, Canada. Currently a Frontend Developer at Rentsync, building Vue applications for the real estate industry. Previously five years of freelance work (200+ websites for 130+ clients across four continents) and a Shopify developer at BOAS.

## Pages

- [Home](https://oviematthew.com): Selected work, about, and contact.
- [Blog](https://oviematthew.com/blog): Technical writing on React, Next.js, mobile development, and AI tooling.
- [Privacy Policy](https://oviematthew.com/privacy-policy)

## Selected work

- [From Ashes](https://oviematthew.com/project/from-ashes): Story-driven open-world game in the browser. Three.js, Supabase, Azure Speech and Blender MCP. A voiced cast, an economy of copper and shillings, stamina and strength progression, stealth, fights, cars, accounts, cloud saves and a Stripe shop.
- [Footy Teams](https://oviematthew.com/project/footy-teams): Web app that builds balanced pickup football teams from a pasted player list. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [Realtor Block](https://oviematthew.com/project/realtor-block): Real estate listings platform with map search and agent accounts. Next.js, Supabase, Clerk, Google Maps API.
- [BOAS](https://oviematthew.com/project/boas): Denim wholesale storefront, migrated from Shopify Liquid to headless Next.js with Strapi.
- [Addict Wellness App](https://oviematthew.com/project/chattee-app): Recovery support app concept with real-time chat and community. React Native, Firebase.
- [Bedge Pictures](https://oviematthew.com/project/bedge-pictures): Wedding photography site with a markdown blog and spam-protected contact form. Next.js, GSAP.
- [Lizz Davies](https://oviematthew.com/project/lizz-davies): Bridal and occasion hairstylist site rebuilt from WordPress to Next.js.

## Skills

React, Next.js, Vue, TypeScript, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Supabase, GraphQL, Shopify, AI-assisted coding.
